definitions.explanation: Goods produced from farm animals — meat, milk, eggs, and hides. A category term used in trade statistics and agricultural policy alongside {農産物|のうさんぶつ} and {水産物|すいさんぶつ}.

examples.japanese: {畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: Imports of livestock products have increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ。
examples.english: This region is a major producer of livestock products.

examples.japanese: ⟦{飼料|しりょう}→飼料：19666_shiryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}がり→値上がり：11538_neagari⟧で、{畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: With feed prices rising, the prices of livestock products are going up as well.

examples.japanese: ⟦{輸出|ゆしゅつ}される→輸出する：01855_yushutsusuru⟧{畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{衛生|えいせい}→衛生：14049_eisei⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: Strict hygiene standards are set for livestock products that are exported.

notes:
⟦{畜産|ちくさん}→畜産：16090_chikusan⟧ is animal husbandry, and the suffix ⟦{物|ぶつ}→〜物：28336_butsu⟧ names the goods it yields. The three category words pattern together and are worth learning as a set.

FORMS:
- ⟦{農産物|のうさんぶつ}→農産物：14360_nousanbutsu⟧: agricultural products (crops)
- ⟦{水産物|すいさんぶつ}→水産物：16545_suisanbutsu⟧: marine products (fish and seafood)
- {林産物|りんさんぶつ}: forest products (timber and related goods)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧／⟦{輸入|ゆにゅう}→輸入：01742_yunyuu⟧: production / import of livestock products
- {畜産物|ちくさんぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: prices of livestock products
